sheets.title: Settings › Capabilities as a guest, no Host — desktop
sheets.caption: Every tile now leads to a page with something to do. Better Auth and the other tiles whose only road is a Host are not drawn, and the Encryption subheader, which only a sealed vault can act under, is gone for a guest.

sheets.title: Cloud secret storage, Password managers, Local storage — desktop
sheets.caption: Eleven cloud secret stores that each ended in a Host form are one tile, Doppler, whose page seals a Connect credential and then creates the connector. The Password managers and Local storage subheaders would draw nothing, so they are not drawn.
sheets.before: Cloud secret storage: 11 tiles, then Password managers (6) and Local storage (2)
sheets.after: Cloud secret storage: 1 tile (Doppler); Password managers and Local storage not drawn

sheets.title: Better Auth, values typed — desktop
sheets.caption: The base draws a Connect form and lets a person fill it in; this branch has no road for it on this device and draws none.
sheets.before: 4 fields, 2 typed (Base URL, API key); 1 Save key
sheets.after: 0 fields, 0 keys; the page has no panel

sheets.title: Better Auth, after pressing Save — desktop
sheets.caption: Before: the values are gone and a 14px ✗ appears at the top of the page. After: there was nothing to press.
sheets.before: Save pressed: base_url and api_key filled → empty; the only feedback is a 14px ✗ at the top of the page (label: "This browser has no approved grant for that action."); bell: none
sheets.after: No key to press: 0 fields, 0 keys, 0 panels; mark: "Not available here"

sheets.title: Encryption with a sealed vault — desktop
sheets.caption: A person with an unlocked vault keeps the four keys that seal there. A guest does not see them: their pages drew an empty Connect panel.
sheets.before: 16 subheaders, 48 tiles; Encryption: YubiKey, AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault Keys, Google Cloud KMS
sheets.after: 14 subheaders, 18 tiles; Encryption: the same four

sheets.title: WorkOS before its Connect credential is sealed — desktop
sheets.caption: The Create connector form was drawn whole, with a key that stayed disabled until the credential above it was sealed. Now the page asks for the credential first.
sheets.before: #connector drawn: 1 key, disabled, before any credential exists
sheets.after: #connector not drawn: the page asks for the credential first

sheets.title: WorkOS, credential sealed, Create pressed with no network — desktop
sheets.caption: A real failing action on a device with no Host. The mark is the same in both builds; this branch also says the sentence in the bell.
sheets.before: mark: "Couldn't reach the connected service."; bell: "Notifications — none", 0 attention keys
sheets.after: same mark; bell: "Notifications — 1 pending", 1 attention key
